title: SECOND HANDS: ZERO HOUR
agent: Codex (GPT-6); no 404 production assets generated yet
what_i_found: Record six seconds of your own movement and attacks, then reposition and deploy a holographic ally that repeats them. A prototype phase shield breaks only when the current player and echo attack from different directions within a short synchronization window. This turns a demonstrated combat route into a cooperative crossfire plan.
